title: Burnaby man dies in police car after bizarre behaviour
article: A Burnaby man is dead after a bizarre incident in which he erratically ran into traffic, jumped into a woman's car, screamed for help and finally suffered an apparent heart attack in the back of a police cruiser.
The man, 33-year-old Mladen Cujko, scared motorists Monday night with his peculiar and violent behaviour.

When police arrived, he agreed to be transported to hospital where he was to undergo an examination under the Mental Health Act. But police say the man became more violent en route and attempted to kick out the windows of the cruiser.
The solo police officer stopped on the Trans Canada Highway and tried to calm the man when a struggle ensued. A passing paramedic team saw the encounter and came to the officer's assistance.
But shortly after Cujko was restrained and put into handcuffs, he went into cardiac arrest. Although treated by the paramedics and rushed to hospital, he was pronounced dead later that evening.
The Victoria RCMP is now investigating the death and an autopsy is scheduled for Thursday to determine the specific cause of death.
The incident is similar to the death of a native carver in Victoria last year.

Anthany Dawson, 26, screamed and ran down a street half-naked last year before suffering a heart attack. At a coroner's inquest last week, a doctor blamed Dawson's bizarre behaviour on a rare genetic disorder. Members of Dawson's family believe police used excessive force and plan to sue. That inquest will resume Nov. 13.
